What this air reference models

Closed idealized dry diatomic air, uniform temperature and chosen lumped jacket conductance. Same conductance gives different Cp/Cv time constants. Moving seal is frictionless and quasistatic at imposed absolute pressure; rigid cap holds volume. No friction, inertia, leaks, real-gas correction, humidity, evaporation, spatial temperature or hardware/jacket thermal-storage solver. Jacket remains below the piston, so no variable water-head force is applied. Gas tint is an optional volume overlay; real air is clear. Close-up crops the apparatus for boundary inspection. Floating gauges and thermometers are calculated diagnostics, not intrusive probes. This is not measured syringe performance or pressure-vessel certification.
